item.title: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
item.description:
Title: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
Genre: Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Magic Fuel Games
Publisher: Playstack
Release Date: Oct 20, 2026




About This Game

Construct complex research facilities across strange new worlds in the first-ever outpost builder set in the Star Trek universe.

Explore diverse tech and buildings trees, and carefully choose which structures will help explore and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens all life in the system.

Lead your crew through dangerous encounters that will test their morale and prowess.

Explore the X'Lehari System, assign tasks to your crew and develop your officers to ensure their survival.

Explore the X’Lehari System with a completely original Star Trek story set in the 23rd century, alongside the era depicted in Star Trek: Strange New Worlds .

Traverse through unique environments, meet new characters, and use iconic technology in your mission to render aid to a fragile civilization’s impending catastrophe.

item.title: Mycopunk
item.description:
Title: Mycopunk
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Pigeons at Play
Publisher: Devolver Digital
Release Date: Oct 20, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 10, 2025




About This Game

A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

Embark on a series of dangerous planet-side missions to drive back the mycological menace. Could this be a simple natural disaster like they claim? And did SAXON really misfile your taxes? Or was that your own fault?




Choose from an outrageous arsenal of advanced futuristic weaponry (and some power tools), then supercharge them in a one-of-a-kind grid-based upgrade system to create the ridiculous sci-fi super-weapon of your dreams.




Slaughter hordes of enemies as they corrupt and weaponize the planet's technology against you. Pick crawlies apart piece by piece — but be wary, whatever they drop could be grabbed up by another enemy.




Every mission grants new mods to jam into your upgrade grids. Mix em, match em, and stack em. Whatever upgrades you can fit in are fair game. Piece by piece, your scrappy robots and weapons mutate into finely-tuned death machines (or horrible mistakes of engineering, up to you). Spec into being a healing support, put a deflector shield on a chainsaw, or turn yourself into a bomb (we don't really care).




Let off steam between missions in an orbital dropship packed with toys and games. Hang out with your friends, uncover more about the galaxy, and shoot the breeze with the insectoid SAXON veteran Roachard Cox.

item.title: We Were Here Tomorrow
item.description:
Title: We Were Here Tomorrow
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie
Developer: Total Mayhem Games
Publisher: Total Mayhem Games
Franchise: We Were Here Series
Release Date: Oct 20, 2026




About This Game

On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become the victims of bad timing, and are trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica.

Once awakened, the world around the two of you is no longer the one you remember. With little recollection of what happened, you find yourselves inside a facility of Norček Industries, where the charismatic Director Kathleen Bowe is waiting for you.

Her team was on the verge of a breakthrough, but they have mysteriously disappeared, leaving their work unfinished. With a global crisis looming, the Director turns to you and your partner to continue where they left off.

To complete their work, you must take on a series of complex tasks throughout the facility. Often separated, you will rely solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. Describe what you see, share what you discover, and combine your perspectives to solve the puzzles that stand in your way.

But be cautious; the deeper you venture into the Norček facility, the more questions begin to surface. What is Norček trying to achieve? Why were you brought here? And what happened to those who came before you?

Only together will you unravel the mysteries surrounding Norček Industries and discover the truth. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow.

Key Features

  • A shared adventure: When fate takes an unexpected turn, two Explorers find themselves trapped inside a mysterious facility. With only each other to rely on, they must uncover its secrets and decide what Tomorrow will hold.

  • Asymmetrical co-op puzzling: No two Explorers experience the facility the same way. Trust your partner, communicate through your walkie-talkies, and combine your unique perspectives to solve puzzles that challenge the rules of time, gravity, and space.

  • Two players, two distinct roles: You and your partner each have a different role to play, with your own high-tech tool at your disposal. Work together and use your equipment in creative ways to overcome obstacles that neither of you could face alone.

  • A mystery in an imagined 80s future: Explore Norček Industries and uncover the secrets behind its experiments and missing research team. Journey through a retro-futuristic world brought to life by striking environments and a nostalgic synthwave soundtrack.

The We Were Here Series

Every game in the We Were Here Series is a standalone online co-op adventure – the stories are connected but you don’t need to play them in order.

Playing with your friend and communicating well is key to the escape room series: asymmetrical puzzles give players different perspectives and can only be solved together.

NOTE: This game is co-op only. It requires both players to have a working PC-compatible microphone and an internet connection.

item.title: GONE Fishing
item.description:
Title: GONE Fishing
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: GONE Studios
Publisher: GONE Studios
Release Date: Oct 20, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jun 15, 2025




About This Game

Cast your line to feed an ancient eldritch beast. Bring friends or go solo. It doesn’t care who is feeding it, only that it is fed. With over 100 different species of creatures to catch and dozens of live animals to use as bait.

Grill it, smoke it, turn it into a pearl, or bet it all in the gambling pit. Sell the extra fish you catch and spend the profits on upgrades, better gear, and items from the traders found around the map.

You must sacrifice a certain amount of fish to the beast every day if you want to survive, but the beast is not the only thing out there. Be wary of territorial beasts, stalking nightmares, and ambushing predators. Learn the creatures of the land to avoid being killed, you can't feed the hungering abomination if you are dead...

Drink beer, explore multiple maps, customize your characters, play instruments, catch fish and legendary creatures like the Lochness monster, explode monsters (and people), AND GAMBLE.

Fight back against the Lake Entity and stop the beast!

item.title: Athanasia
item.description:
Title: Athanasia
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , Early Access
Developer: Momentum Games LLC
Publisher: Black Lantern Collective
Release Date: Oct 19, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 19, 2026




About This Game

Inspired by classics like System Shock and Dino Crisis, Athanasia challenges you to outthink and outmanoeuvre the brute strength of your ancient adversaries.

You are Carmen Flores, researcher and explorer, called to investigate a mysterious facility in South America where reports of disappearances and strange phenomena abound. Within this winding maze of secrets and science lies a terrible truth and ancestral nightmares that have plagued us for longer than we have been human.

How will you survive?

EXPLORATION

Use your wits to navigate hidden pathways and discover forgotten secrets. Gather knowledge of your foes and surroundings to take dynamic approaches to tense, hair-trigger encounters. Find caches of vital equipment and the audio logs of those who lived, worked and died in this forsaken place.

SURVIVAL

Conserve scarce resources, pick fights wisely, and underestimate the enemy at your own peril. From creatures that once ruled the world to things previously unseen by human eyes, you must strategically utilize an arsenal of tools and deadly weapons to overcome the facility’s dangers. Find and combine items to create improvised weapons, distractions, traps, and more.

IMMERSION

Between the dinosaurs and a facility-wide lockdown, navigating this labyrinth will be no simple matter. Hack into computers, jimmy open doors, and refuel machines to open new paths. Get to the bottom of what really happened here and find things you were never supposed to see.

KEY FEATURES

  • Exploration & Discovery: Unearth buried truths as you navigate a lab overtaken by dinosaurs and [REDACTED]

  • Crafting: Find and combine resources to craft essential tools and items

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Overcome lethal encounters using stealth, wit, and an arsenal of weapons

  • Environmental Depth: Engage with a detailed, highly interactive environment

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Violence and blood throughout



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7+
    • Processor: 2.4GHZ Dual Core Processor Or Higher
    • Memory: 4 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 660 or Equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 9.0
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: 2.4GHZ Dual Core Processor Or Higher
    • Memory: 8 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 750 or Equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
